narr: A warm front lifted northward off the Gulf Coast, causing rapid moisture transport to the Mid-South. In addition, an upper-level trough and associated cold front approached the area. This led to showers in the afternoon and then severe thunderstorms that continued through the overnight hours. Damaging wind, hail, tornadoes, and flash flooding were the result.
ev: Highway 54 North and Ross Road were flooded.
The I-55 Exit at Mclemore Avenue was flooded. Several cars are partially submerged.
